p: We have already spoken of this,
bestow the inner light into the heart,
which is the aspect of Yosef HaTzaddik,
into the heart of the souls of Yisrael.
And for this reason the main berachah
was instituted on the taking of the lulav,
and also the main part of the shaking
in order to shake with it.
And it is brought in the Tikkunim
correspond to the eighteen vertebrae of the spine,
which are in the Tzaddik, "Chai Olamin," the Life of the Worlds.
Now, the essence of the inner light
is the bestowal of the light of Torah,
so that through it one attains
the illumination of His Divinity, may He be blessed,
as it says, "Hashem is my light and my salvation"
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר אֵל ה׳ וַיָּאֶר לָנוּ
and as it says, "Hashem is God, and He has given us light"
and it says, "Though I sit in darkness,
Hashem is a light for me"
through the four species of the lulav,
which are the aspect of the seven middos
in all of which the illumination of the Torah is found.
For Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
who shone forth from the wisdom of the Torah,
for the two thousand years of Torah
began from Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him
on the pasuk "Let there be light,
And Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him —
the Torah came forth from Gevurah.
And Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
was the root of the Torah of truth.
And Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
was the one who bestowed the entire Torah.
"The Torah of truth was in his mouth"
"and Torah they shall seek from his mouth"
And Yosef HaTzaddik was a "ben zekunim,"
for all the halachos of Shem and Ever
And this is what is said,
for truth is that which is fixed in the heart
and Yosef is the channel drawing it
from Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
who for this reason are called by his name,
and as is known, that body and bris
meaning that the aspect of Yosef
is that wisdom has already been acquired in the heart.
וְלָכֵן מְכוּנֶּה שֵׁם זֶה עַל זָקֵן,
Therefore this name is applied to an elder,
in the inwardness of the heart
until the days of old age.
And this is the root of the inner light,
when the illumination is absorbed in the heart.
And David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
and he is the aspect of Mashiach,
who is an individual who repented,
and through whom forgiveness is granted
that is, that a thought of teshuvah will enter
the heart of all the souls of Yisrael,
and then it will become clear
that the inwardness of their heart
is full of the illumination of Divinity,
and "our will is to do Your will,
are from the leaven in the dough"
is the light spreading without limit,
for his middah is the aspect of Gedulah,
as it says, "Yours, Hashem, is the greatness"
such that there is nothing above it,
as we spoke concerning "a great feast."
the aspect of Gevurah and contraction of Yitzchak,
that it be within limit and contraction,
so that it may have a hold
And on this, "the Torah came forth from Gevurah,"
that is, within limit and measures —
in the six hundred thirteen mitzvos
and in the letters of the Torah, by number.
And the aspect of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
who is also on the right line,
for the bestowal of words of Torah
that is within the inwardness of the words of Torah,
as it says, "Its measure is longer than the earth"
meaning that even the measure of the Torah —
there is depth in the Torah
for each one to grasp with his mind,
in the depth of the words of Torah,
in fresh insight in its pilpul,
And Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
is of the aspect of the Daas
of the illumination of words of Torah
is the aspect of Aharon on the left line,
which contracts the aspect of Daas
so that it not spread out,
as it says, "and the lips of a Kohen
the illumination is drawn to the community,
וְהַיְינוּ עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת יַעֲקֹב וְיוֹסֵף,
that is, through the aspect of Yaakov and Yosef,
for Yaakov is the one who balances
and Yosef is of the aspect of Netzach and Hod.
And it is known that Yaakov is from without
for the aspect of Moshe, which is Daas,
in the inwardness of his heart
וְיַעֲקֹב הוּא גַּם כֵּן בְּחִינָה זוֹ,
and Yaakov is also this aspect,
in that all his outward movements
were according to the illumination of Divinity
that is, he made no movement at all
זוּלַת מַה שֶּׁהוּא רְצוֹן הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
other than what was the will of Hashem, may He be blessed,
which the aspect of truth revealed upon him.
And on this one may apply
on the pasuk "Why did you do me harm
and it brings that he said,
"My way is hidden from Hashem," etc.
and the commentators emended it to
for certainly this is his aspect,
And what he said, "Why did you do me harm," etc.,
גַּם כֵּן לֹא הָיָה שֶׁל בַּטָּלָה,
that even if there will be someone
"My way is hidden from Hashem," etc.,
he will be included in the congregation of Yaakov.
And this is like what Chazal said
on the pasuk "If your sins be
from the six days of Creation —
they shall become white as snow."
That is, it was so arranged
by His will, may He be blessed,
that such a thing should come before him,
so that they be turned to merit.

the aspect of a Torah of truth,
so that it will not be idle.
And this matter is mentioned in its place
regarding Tavi, the servant of Rabban Gamliel,
for in the sukkah the time brings this about,
the inner light from the knowledge of Divinity
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף
as it says, "These are the generations of Yaakov: Yosef"
for he draws down a comprehensive illumination
and as it says, "Light is sown for the tzaddik"
"The light was given to the tzaddikim."
And we have already spoken of this
that there appeared to him the image of the likeness
meaning that the light appeared to him
that "he entered to attend to his needs,"
who, Heaven forbid, was not seduced
by the desires of his soul.
אָמְנָם הוּא עַל פִּי אָמְרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה
Rather, it is according to the saying of Chazal
that she too intended it for the sake of Heaven,
that she was destined to raise children from him.
And certainly their intent is not
to judge the gentile women favorably,
but rather to magnify thereby the test,
and that certainly Yosef HaTzaddik, too,
and because of this he came close
However, when there appeared in his heart
which is the image of the likeness of his father,
שֶׁעַל כָּל פָּנִים לֹא יוּצְמַח מִזֶּה
that in any event there would not grow from this
as it says, "The lip of truth
and through this he withstood the test.
וְהוּא גַּם כֵּן עַל פִּי הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל,
And this too is in line with the above,
from the knowledge of Divinity in the aspect of truth
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף,
as it says, "These are the generations of Yaakov: Yosef,"
and it says, "Light is sown for the tzaddik."
